title: fix(spec): the AI blueprint object and view follow the object and view rules (stage-field option kinds, icon, OBJECT.KEY view names)

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DYVJCX6wVSuZ5wrJuYHTtbH)_

domain:spec#3 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwwGpFXKeedERhEqbm

Fixes #32762
Fixes #32763
Fixes #32764
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — no file under `skills/**` restates a blueprint object or view key (`skills/objectstack-ai/references/_index.md` only points at `solution-blueprint.zod.ts`); the reference page `content/docs/references/ai/solution-blueprint.mdx` is regenerated from the new describes.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:AI 搭建方案(blueprint)的对象和视图跟正式对象、视图的规则对齐了三处:① 对象指定了阶段字段(stageField)时，每个选项都必须写明生命周期 kind,缺了在解析时就拒绝(和对象保存时是同一个函数);② 对象可以带 `icon`;③ 视图名可以写成 `对象.视图键`,前提是前缀就是这个视图所属的对象。
- **为什么改**:以前 AI 少写 kind 时方案能通过，系统先建了看板视图和导航，最后对象保存失败，留下指向不存在对象的半成品;AI 被要求给对象设图标，方案里却放不进去，搭出来的表全是通用图标;AI 用 `ticket.open_list` 这种平台到处在用的视图名，会被方案直接拒绝。
- **风险与回滚**:第 ① 处是收紧，被拒的方案里，阶段字段只出现一次的，以前在保存对象那一步也一定失败;唯一的例外是同一个字段名写了两遍(一条带 kind、一条不带),以前可能留下干净的那条而保存成功，现在会被拒，补法是给同名的每一条都写上 kind,或删掉重复的那条;严格输出(模型生成用的那份)每个对象多了一个必填可空的 `icon` 键，云端拼装严格输出的测试夹具要补 `icon: null`。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:① `packages/spec/src/ai/solution-blueprint.zod.ts` 的 `refuseBlueprintStageFieldWithoutKinds`(数组转字段表、路径换成下标);② 同文件 `BLUEPRINT_VIEW_NAME` 与 `refuseForeignViewQualifier`;③ `packages/spec/dropped-refinements.baseline.json` 新增的两个 refinement 位置(账本只缩不涨，这里是新规则带来的增长，请席位确认)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/ai/solution-blueprint.test.ts`,预期 120 个用例全过，其中「the blueprint object runs the object schema's stage-field rule」「blueprint object `icon`」「blueprint view `name`」三组是本 PR 新增。
- **需要你做的**:无，席位落地。

## What changes

Three places where the AI solution blueprint (`SolutionBlueprintSchema`, the shape `apply_blueprint` parses) disagreed with the object and view schemas the applier writes through. One commit per card (`b46fb13b` #32764, `d89238ee` #32763, `d5366c7f` #32762), then the one `origin/main` merge, then three bookkeeping commits the gates asked for (the dropped-refinements ledger header total, the ADR-0087 disposition, and its ledger entry).

- **#32764: the blueprint object runs the object schema's stage-field rule (narrowed).** `BlueprintObjectSchema` gains `.superRefine(refuseBlueprintStageFieldWithoutKinds)`, which hands EVERY entry of the blueprint's field ARRAY whose `name` is the stage field (a one-entry map each, located by that entry's own index) to `refuseStageFieldWithoutKinds`, the very function `ObjectSchema` runs. To make that one function and not a copy, it moves unchanged out of `data/object.zod.ts` into the new non-barrel module `packages/spec/src/data/stage-field-kinds.ts`; the only addition is a defaulted `spelling` parameter (how a shape locates a field under `fields`, and the "no lifecycle" remedy: `stageField: false` on an object, "omit `stageField`" on a blueprint, which has no `false` arm). Issues land at `objects[i].fields[j].options[k].kind` and `objects[i].stageField`. `ObjectSchema`'s behaviour and messages are byte-identical (same default spelling).
- **#32763: a blueprint object carries `icon` (added).** `ObjectSchema.icon`'s leaf moves into the new non-barrel module `packages/spec/src/data/object-icon.ts` (`OBJECT_ICON_SCHEMA`, same `z.string().optional()` and same describe), and `ObjectSchema`, `BlueprintObjectSchema` and the strict mirror's `StrictObject` all read that one leaf (the mirror as `.unwrap().nullable()`, required-but-nullable like every strict key). Reading the leaf from `ObjectSchema` directly was measured and rejected: it pulls `object.zod.ts` into the `/ai` entry, 293.3 KB → 631.1 KB minified (esbuild bundle of `dist/ai/index.mjs`, zod external); with the shared module the entry is 297.1 KB.
- **#32762: a view may be named `OBJECT.KEY` (added).** `BlueprintViewSchema.name` takes `BLUEPRINT_VIEW_NAME` (bare `SNAKE_CASE` key, optionally qualified by one `SNAKE_CASE` segment), and `.superRefine(refuseForeignViewQualifier)` refuses a qualifier that is not the view's own `object`, at `views[i].name`, naming both accepted spellings. The strict mirror keeps the bare key only: the qualifier rule is cross-key and a per-leaf mirror cannot state it, so admitting a dot there would let the model generate `case.x` on a `ticket` view (legal to propose, refused at apply: the cloud#1967 shape). Narrower mirror is the safe direction; it is listed, with its reason, as the one `DELIBERATE_NARROWER_MIRROR` path in the VALUE-parity pin, which also fails if that entry stops drifting.

### The other view doors, measured before choosing (#32762's ask)

They agree; no fork.

| Door | `name` rule | Qualified `OBJECT.KEY` | Bare key |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| `ViewItemNameSchema` (standalone ViewItem record, `ui/view.zod.ts`) | `QUALIFIED_ITEM_NAME_PATTERN`, dot required | required | refused |
| `ViewSchema` container / flattened overlay (`ui/view.zod.ts`) | `z.string().optional()` | accepted | accepted |
| metadata publish door (`METADATA_ITEM_NAME_PATTERN`, `shared/identifiers.zod.ts`) | dot-qualified segments, qualifier optional | accepted | accepted |
| lint `resolvesViewId` (`packages/lint/src/lint-view-refs.ts`, lock-step with objectui `resolveViewId`) | `key` ≡ `OBJECT.key` when the prefix is the view's object | accepted, same view | accepted |
| cloud stager `viewName` (`service-ai-studio` blueprint-tools.ts) | per the card's measurement through the real door; cloud is not in this session's repos | accepted | accepted |

No door refuses the qualified form, and the one that resolves spellings to a view treats `OBJECT.key` as `key` only when the prefix is the view's own object, which is the rule this PR adopts. `ViewItemNameSchema` does not check the prefix against `object` at all; the blueprint carries `object` beside `name`, so it can and does.

## Tests

`packages/spec/src/ai/solution-blueprint.test.ts`, 120 tests (103 before):

- Stage field: the 1:1-copy test now pins the refusal at both doors (blueprint at `objects.0.fields.1.options.3.kind`, object at `fields.status.options.3.kind`); one issue per kind-less option; locate by array index wherever the stage field sits; a multi-value stage field refused at `stageField`; every entry carrying the stage field's name judged at its own index, in both orders (a kind-less duplicate after a clean one, and before it); unchanged cases (no `stageField`, undeclared field, option-less field) accepted; and a parity walk over nine cases asserting the blueprint and `ObjectSchema` refuse the same cases with the same issue count (four refusals, so the walk is not vacuous).
- Icon: lenient and strict leaves are `ObjectSchema.shape.icon`'s inner leaf by identity; carried through the lenient parse into a body `ObjectSchema` accepts; optional, and a non-string refused at `objects.0.icon`; required-but-nullable on the strict mirror.
- View name: bare accepted; `ticket.open_list` on a `ticket` view accepted and carried as written; `case.open_list` refused at `views.0.name` (`custom`); `ticket.open.list`, `Ticket.open_list`, `ticket.`, `.open_list`, `ticket/open_list`, `open-list` each refused once by the pattern; the strict mirror's name refuses the dot; `BlueprintViewSchema` alone judges the same rule.
- Strict-mirror fixtures gain `icon: null` (8 sites).

Ablations, each through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the final file (the test imports `src/` directly, so no rebuild leg), each restored with the blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty:

| Mutation | Red |
|:---|:---|
| drop `.superRefine(refuseBlueprintStageFieldWithoutKinds)` | 5 (the stage-field tests) |
| drop `.superRefine(refuseForeignViewQualifier)` | 2 (foreign qualifier) |
| view name back to `.regex(SNAKE_CASE)` | 4 (qualified accept, foreign qualifier, VALUE parity) |
| lenient icon re-declared as `z.string().optional()` | 1 (identity pin) |
| adapter judges only the first entry carrying the stage field's name (`findIndex(...) !== index` skip) | 1 (the every-entry test) |

## Acceptance notes

- **First-party exposure of the narrowing (#32764), counted before narrowing:** 0. No blueprint literal exists in this tree outside the spec's own test (`defineSolutionBlueprint` / `SolutionBlueprintSchema` / `BlueprintObjectSchema` greps over `examples/`, `apps/`, `packages/`, `ui/`), and 0 in hotcrm (`git grep` for `SolutionBlueprint`, `defineSolutionBlueprint`, `apply_blueprint`). Blueprints are produced at runtime by the cloud design step; every one this now refuses whose stage field name appears once was already refused by the object write; one that declares the stage field's name twice (one entry with kinds, one without) may have applied before and is refused now, remedy: give every same-named entry its kinds, or remove the duplicate (contract review 6839400443).
- **Ledger growth for the seat to adjudicate:** `packages/spec/dropped-refinements.baseline.json` gains `""` on `ai/BlueprintObject` and `ai/BlueprintView`, and `objects.element` / `views.element` on `ai/SolutionBlueprint`: the two new refinements are cross-key and have no arm in the closed projectable list, so the published JSON Schema stays wider than the runtime there (annotated `x-dropped-refinements`). The ledger is shrink-only on repairs; this is growth from new rules, the same shape the blueprint field's `defaultValue` refinement added.
- **Strict output contract:** `SolutionBlueprintStrictSchema.objects[]` gains a required-nullable `icon`. A producer that builds strict output by hand (cloud's design-step tests and fixtures) owes `icon: null` or a name. `carrier: cloud`: passing `objects[].icon` to the staged object and its nav entry, and the defence-in-depth #32764 names (not staging a refused object's dependents).
- `ObjectSchema` is unchanged on the wire: the moved function's default spelling reproduces its path and messages byte-for-byte, and `content/docs/references/data/**` did not regenerate.
- **ADR-0087:** `check-adr-0087-registration` refuses `not-required` on a `narrowed` changeset, so the narrowing is registered as the D3 entry `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.blueprint-stage-field-option-kind-required.ts` (no conversion: a blueprint is never persisted, and which option is terminal is the producer's to say), beside the object's own `stage-field-option-kind-required`. File surface amended on the claim for this file too.
- `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` (amended after contract review 6838283650, claim re-posted as 6838331012): the fold mixes a widening (#32762, #32763) with two narrowed accept sets, the lenient refusal (#32764, whose refused set was already refused downstream except a blueprint declaring the stage field's name twice) and the strict mirror's now-required `icon` (#32763). The changeset carries the same line and a BREAKING sentence naming both. `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` (several ⇒ narrowed), so `minor`.
- Serial sibling: #32529's PR edits only comment lines ~:234-241 of the same file; disjoint.
